successCriteria.description: tests/unit/modules/auth/auth.service.test.ts restores process.env.JWT_SECRET to its pre-suite value after the suite completes — capturing the original value before beforeAll sets 'unit-test-jwt-secret', and in afterAll restoring it (or deleting the key when it was originally unset) so no other test file observes the leaked secret.

tests/unit/modules/leave/leave.routes.test.ts contains a test asserting GET /leaves/:id returns a 404 with code NOT_FOUND for a nonexistent id (an id absent from the store), distinct from the existing not-visible case.

tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.routes.test.ts contains a test asserting GET /employees/me returns a 404 with code NOT_FOUND when the employee service throws NotFoundError (unknown employee profile), using the established route-test seam.

constraints: Test-only phase: no production source files (src/) may change; only the two named test files are in scope.

The JWT_SECRET restore must capture the original value (including the unset case) before any mutation and restore it in afterAll, so the suite is order-independent and does not leak the test secret into other suites.
The NotFoundError test must assert the typed error surfaces as HTTP 404 with code NOT_FOUND (matching the shared-errors contract), not merely a thrown error.
outOfScope: No changes to production source (src/), migrations, smoke.js, or any test file other than the two named files.
No new test coverage beyond the JWT_SECRET restore and the NotFoundError test — existing assertions in both files are not to be weakened or rewritten.

ambiguities.description: The intent states the NotFoundError test is "missing" from employee.routes.test.ts, but the file already contains a 404/NOT_FOUND test ("returns 404 / NOT_FOUND when the actor has no employee profile") that throws NotFoundError. The phase must decide whether the existing test already satisfies the intent (no-op) or whether a distinct/additional NotFoundError case is required.
options: Treat the existing 404/NOT_FOUND test as already satisfying the intent — no new test needed
Add a distinct NotFoundError test (e.g. a different trigger path or a more explicit assertion) while keeping the existing one
The intent refers to a different file (leave.routes.test.ts) and the employee test is already complete

ambiguities.description: Whether the JWT_SECRET restore should delete the key when it was originally unset, or restore it to an empty string/undefined. The shared auth module throws when JWT_SECRET is unset, so the exact restore semantics matter for downstream suites.
options: restore to the captured value (undefined) via assignment

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The NotFoundError test must reuse the NotFoundError class and its code 'NOT_FOUND' exactly as defined in the shared errors module, and follow the existing route-test seam (decorate the service, decorateRequest('user', undefined), preHandler setting request.user, app.inject) already used in the same file.

The JWT_SECRET restore must match the timezone-restore pattern already established in the shared date test (capture original in beforeAll, restore in afterAll), so the auth suite follows the same env-cleanup convention.

The auth test's JWT_SECRET value must remain compatible with signToken/verifyToken in the shared auth module (the secret is read from process.env.JWT_SECRET at call time), so the restore does not break the success-path token assertion.
